title: Deciphering The 2024 National Crime Victimization Survey
discussion_signal: The post discusses the 2024 NCVS finding of no statistically significant change while stressing a methodological change and greater uncertainty. A reply contrasts NCVS and FBI trends, preserving a counter-signal that survey victimization and police-recorded crime can diverge without proving underreporting.
linked_research_question: How does public safety differ when measured as lived victimization, police reporting, or administrative record?
limits: The LinkedIn post summarizes the underlying survey and methodology
A reply is a viewpoint, not independent validation
Divergence between measures does not by itself identify the cause
